output.summary: A winter annual herb native to the Middle East, North Africa and southern Europe, it commonly occupies dry, disturbed ground. Developing seedpods rise above its compact yellow flower heads. Its spicy leaves, seeds and flowers are edible, while cured pods can be parched, ground into meal and cooked in soup or stew.
